physiology:
The traditions seat this code in the sacral plexus, the deep nerve net behind the lower belly that runs the body's long cycles, the slow openings and closings, the work of finishing one thing so the next can begin. It is the floor where endings live. The body knows how to end well before the mind catches up.

The shadow has its bodily floor here as a kind of held breath that never quite lets out. The waiting at the platform is also a waiting in the gut. A pelvis that has gone still without the person noticing. A subtle bracing against the next loss, the next change, the next handing-over. Years of that bracing settle as a tiredness that no rest fixes, because the body was never allowed to close the cycle it was inside.

The climb out begins below thought. The pelvis softens. The long out-breath finally comes. Something quietly finishes itself, a season, a feeling, a version of you, and the body lets it. People often describe this as grief that does not hurt, which is the strangest part. The cells already knew. They have been doing this on a seven-year clock since you were born, dying and being remade while you slept, and the gift is only the moment you stop arguing with what the body has always been doing without your permission.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the organ, this code answers to a single amino acid, Leucine, one of the small set the body cannot make for itself. It comes in from the world, is taken apart at the table, and only then does the chemistry of cellular turnover have what it needs.

Leucine is one of the letters the body uses to decide when a cell is finished. It signals the slow work of breaking the old down so something else can be put in its place. The Ring of Life and Death runs on this letter, and the ring is the seven-year cycle, a body that quietly replaces itself while you are doing other things.

There is a teaching in that. The card that looks like it is about disappointment, about waiting for the train, is in fact a card about how the body finishes things. The chemistry does not wait. Cells are ending in you as you read this, with no grasping, only the small clean completion of one round and the start of another. The code runs all the way down to this. An ending the body already knows how to make.
